collection_limitations: Initial baseline attempt stopped before scene entry on strict SurfaceFlinger layer detection; retained as failed evidence.
Empty-cache repeat capture stopped after the complete 60-second window while waiting for thermal stability. Additional high-frequency polling is excluded; original completed:false is retained.

Warm startup capture resumed after ADB interruption with the same PID/config and before first scene entry. Thermal coverage gap is retained and excludes the first settled window from thermal comparison.
All entry windows include dynamic refresh modes; drop percentages are null. Missing or stale SurfaceFlinger observations are flagged.
Preparation windows include operator wait/menu time, and game-data entry is not a loading-complete event.
Only one run per configuration; no statistically replicated end-to-end performance benefit established.
